message.content:
This vertical, rectangular editorial illustration follows a black, white, and red color scheme. At the top, thin black letters read "EDISI KHUSUS" above the large, bold black word "TEMPO." Below, smaller text states "EDISI 30 SEPTEMBER-6 OKTOBER 2013." A thick red horizontal band contains the word "LEKRA" in large, weathered white block letters.

The central graphic depicts two white, line-drawn human hands against a background of radiating black and white diagonal stripes. The left hand holds two paintbrushes with white bristles. The right hand grips a cylindrical object with three circular holes, resembling a flute or recorder. The hands are positioned at the bottom, angled upward toward the center.

A thin black border encloses the central graphic. At the bottom right, small black text includes "RP 33.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and an ISSN barcode. A final red horizontal band at the bottom contains the white text "DAN GEGER 1965." The entire composition is framed by a thick white border.
